# NFR-002: Checksum verification latency

## Description

Checksum verification SHALL complete within one second per artifact.

## Acceptance Criteria

| ID | Criteria | Verification |
|----|----------|--------------|
| NFR-002-AC-1 | Verifying a 10 MB artifact completes within one second. | Test |

## Dependencies

- None.
